title.zh: 质量守恒 · 原子一个都不丢
title.en: Mass Conservation · Not a Single Atom Lost

desc.zh: 化学反应看起来变重变轻，原子却一个不多、一个不少，只是重新排队。这一页把反应拆开逐个原子数，再用天平对账：敞口跑掉的气体、从空气里加入的氧，都逃不过这本账。
desc.en: Reactions seem to gain or lose weight, yet not a single atom is created or destroyed — they only reshuffle. Take reactions apart and count atoms one by one, then settle it on a balance: escaping gas and oxygen joining from the air both show up in the ledger.
